title: Putin's glam propagandist killed by landmine on Ukraine border
description: Anna Prokofieva, 35, a war correspondent for Russia's state-run TV network Channel One, was killed after the vehicle she and her cameraman were traveling in ran over a landmine in Russia's Belgorod region, state television announced on Wednesday.

title: French President Macron pledges $2.15B for Ukraine defense
description: French President Emmanuel Macron during a meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky pledged the equivalent of $2.15 billion in U.S. dollars to support Ukraine's defense against Russia.

title: Both sides accused of breaking ceasefire
description: Russia and Ukraine have accused each other of breaking the terms of a tentative U.S-brokered deal to pause strikes on energy infrastructure, underscoring the challenges to negotiating a broader peace in the war in Ukraine.

title: Macron says a proposed European force for Ukraine could 'respond' if attacked by Russia.
description: PARIS (AP) — French President Emmanuel Macron said Wednesday that a proposed European armed force for possible deployment in Ukraine in tandem with an eventual peace deal could “respond” to a Russian attack if Moscow launched one.
